create_squared_error: create elementwise squared error between predictions and targets for regression
build_l2_loss: build L2 loss as half the squared error between predictions and targets
test_huber_loss: test huber loss with configurable delta for robust regression with L1/L2 behavior
run_log_cosh: run log-cosh loss as twice-differentiable alternative to Huber loss for regression
compute_cosine_distance: compute cosine distance between prediction and target vectors for similarity measurement
